rationale: Merge the standalone Byrd Ranch and Meyersdale Energy Storage records into GlidePath Power Solutions. Quinbrook identifies GlidePath as the manager-level portfolio company and both facilities as projects beneath it. Byrd Ranch is a 50 MW/50 MWh Texas project held through Byrd Ranch Storage LLC, while Meyersdale is an 18 MW/12 MWh Pennsylvania project held through Meyersdale Storage, LLC. No separate project-level Quinbrook fund mandate, co-owner, later sponsor transfer or signed pending ownership transaction was found through September 1, 2026. Both project/SPV identities and their operating histories are preserved as GlidePath aliases, milestones and citations.

companyFieldUpdates.description: GlidePath Power Solutions develops, owns and operates battery-energy-storage projects across U.S. power markets. Quinbrook acquired the platform in 2017 through its low-carbon power strategy and continues to list GlidePath as a portfolio company. The platform's operating projects include Byrd Ranch, a 50 MW/50 MWh ERCOT battery facility in Sweeny, Texas held through Byrd Ranch Storage LLC, and Meyersdale, an 18 MW/12 MWh PJM battery facility in Somerset County, Pennsylvania held through Meyersdale Storage, LLC. Byrd Ranch entered the portfolio in 2019 and began operating in November 2022; Meyersdale entered service in 2015, was acquired by GlidePath on March 19, 2019 and was repowered in late 2024. These project/SPV identities are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later GlidePath sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.
